# PROC002: print-outside-presenter

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

A crate outside the repository's declared presenters prints with a print macro.

A repository-local policy: only repositories that list crates in
`[check] output_presenters` are checked. Matches `println!`, `eprintln!`,
`print!` and `eprint!` invocations in the syntax tree outside test code.
Emit a `tracing` event instead, or move the output into a presenter crate.

## Examples

### PROC002 print macro outside the presenter crates / A println in an unlisted crate fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
=== frob.toml
[check]
output_presenters = ["present"]
=== crates/other/src/lib.rs
//! Other.
pub fn f() {
    println!("hello");
}
```

### PROC002 print macro outside the presenter crates / A println in a test module is clean #2 (line 21) (clean)

```text
=== frob.toml
[check]
output_presenters = ["present"]
=== crates/other/src/lib.rs
//! Other.
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    fn t() {
        println!("hello");
    }
}
```

### PROC002 print macro outside the presenter crates / A println-like word in a string is clean #3 (line 37) (clean)

```text
=== frob.toml
[check]
output_presenters = ["present"]
=== crates/other/src/lib.rs
//! Other.
pub const S: &str = "println!(x)";
```
